name: fund-tracker-desktop
description: 恭喜发财本地 Tauri 桌面应用

scripts.check: node --check app/config-schema.js && node --check app/theme.js && node --check app/tauri-shell.js && for f in renderer/*.js app/app.js app/modules/*.js app/modules/watchlist/*.js; do node --check "$f"; done && cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.build:all: npm run build:mac:raw && npm run build:win:raw
scripts.build:mac:raw: npm run frontend:prepare && tauri build --bundles app && node scripts/package-tauri.js mac
scripts.build:win:raw: npm run frontend:prepare && tauri build --no-bundle && node scripts/package-tauri.js win
